summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process with an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt. They have offline assays and note the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up. They request an initial comparison plan and questions before choosing a probe.
